about: What debriefs and exit accounts have cost, measured from the usage annotations of every run on file that debriefed a seat in the present way (scripts/debrief-costs.ts; the table is in docs/behaviour/debrief.md). microusd is the figure used: the largest measured (a shortfall is costlier than a surplus, which is simply not spent). The run multiplies it by margin_percent (a whole number, per cent). A model with no entry gets the floor: the greater of the old reckoning at its price and the largest figure here, times margin_percent. Add a model by measuring it, not by editing a figure.
